title: Projective cosimplicial resolutions paired with injective simplicial weights
statement:
Use the complete, cocomplete model-category, weak-equivalence and Reedy conventions of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure], and simplicial sets with the Kan model structure of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Fix a small ordinary category $J$ and containing universes. Let $\mathcal M$ be any model category for which $\mathcal M^J$ has the projective model structure, with objectwise weak equivalences and fibrations. Let $V^\bullet:\Delta\to\mathcal M^J$ be Reedy cofibrant in this projective model category, and suppose every cosimplicial structure map is an objectwise weak equivalence. Give $\mathrm{sSet}^{J^{\mathrm{op}}}$ the injective model structure of [lem-coef-combinatorial-injective-diagram-model], whose weak equivalences and cofibrations are objectwise. For $K:J^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$ and $T\in\mathcal M$, define
$$L_VK=\int^{j\in J}\int^{[n]\in\Delta}V^n(j)\cdot K(j)_n,\qquad (R_VT)(j)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(V^n(j),T).$$
Here $Z\cdot S=\coprod_{s\in S}Z$, the coend is the coproduct modulo the relations induced by arrows of $J$ and $\Delta$, and the simplicial operators and the $J^{\mathrm{op}}$-action of $R_VT$ are precomposition. These formulas define an adjunction $L_V\dashv R_V$. The functor $L_V$ sends objectwise monomorphisms to cofibrations in $\mathcal M$, and sends objectwise monomorphisms that are objectwise weak homotopy equivalences to trivial cofibrations. Thus this is a Quillen adjunction for the injective structure on its source. No simplicial enrichment of $\mathcal M$, no properness hypothesis, and no nonemptiness condition on $J$ are imposed.

source.place: Hirschhorn, Model Categories and Their Localizations, Lemma 19.2.14(1), Theorem 19.3.1(1) and Theorem 19.4.4, printed pp.411–415 (PDF pp.425–429). Agent adaptation of the weighted-coend lifting calculation: projective cofibrancy is imposed on the entire cosimplicial diagram and weights carry the injective model structure. This strengthened interchange is not asserted to be the literal statement of 19.3.1, whose weights are projective. No Stacks tag states this model-category result.
